title: 云计算和SaaS产业结构分析：技术、基础设施、应用层、资本信号和风险信号
core_insight: 今日云计算和SaaS产业结构变化主要体现在技术层面的AI和云原生应用的推进，以及基础设施层的扩张和安全性的增强

dimension_texts.technology: AWS、Google Cloud和Azure推出了新的云原生服务，火山引擎发布ByteHouse，作为ClickHouse企业版 AWS、Google Cloud和Azure推出了新的基础设施更新，包括智能存储层和Post-quantum encryption The AWS MCP Server is now generally available Ship code within minutes with the Gemini CLI DevOps Extension Scaling cloud and AI: Microsoft Azure’s commitment to Europe’s digital future 从 ClickHouse 到 ByteHouse：实时数据分析场景下的优化实践 Post-quantum encryption for Cloudflare IPsec is generally available
dimension_texts.infrastructure: AWS、Google Cloud和Azure推出了新的定价策略和区域扩张 AWS、Google Cloud和Azure推出了新的计算资源和芯片供应 AWS Interconnect is now generally available, with a new option to simplify last-mile connectivity Google Cloud expands to new regions and introduces new pricing strategy Optimize object storage costs automatically with smart tier—now generally available
dimension_texts.application: Salesforce、Adobe和HubSpot推出了新的行业解决方案和产品 AWS、Google Cloud和Azure推出了新的云原生服务，帮助企业实现数字化转型 Point of Sale Innovations to Modernize the Shopper Experience Our Vision for Building an Open Ecosystem for the Agent Era AI 重构测试行业！火山引擎云手机应用助手重磅来袭！
dimension_texts.capital: Nvidia已经投资了40亿美元于AI领域 Cloudflare的收入创历史新高，但也宣布了大规模裁员 AWS和Salesforce的战略投资和收购继续推动行业发展 Nvidia has already committed $40B to equity AI deals this year
